risk_if_not_implemented: Without Data Catalog, security events may go undetected, allowing threats to persist and increasing breach dwell time.

compensating_control_1.name: Information Location
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document the location of information and the specific system components on which the information resides.
compensating_control_1.justification: Information Location (DCH-24) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Data Catalog (GOV-10.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data & Asset Classification
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure data and assets are categorized in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data & Asset Classification (DCH-02) provides asset and inventory visibility that compensates for the absence of Data Catalog (GOV-10.1) by providing the foundational asset knowledge needed to manage risks associated with the primary control. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
